lessons.title: Never assume /tmp is writable on Termux
lessons.symptom: Piped jq extractions to /tmp/*.json silently fail with Permission denied.
lessons.root_cause: Termux does not guarantee /tmp is writable. $TMPDIR is the correct path.
lessons.fix: Always write to $TMPDIR (guaranteed writable) or .cache/ within the project.

lessons.title: Never assume JSON field names — inspect with jq keys first
lessons.symptom: ADR catalog produced 0 records despite 36 allocation records existing.
lessons.root_cause: Query used .allocations (null) but actual field is .allocated (array of 36).
lessons.fix: Run jq "keys" before consuming external JSON.

lessons.title: Heredoc on stdin overrides pipe, breaking Python read()
lessons.symptom: Python extractor produced empty output despite git show returning data.
lessons.root_cause: out=$(git show ... | python3 - <<'PY') consumed heredoc as stdin, not git show output. sys.stdin.read() returned the heredoc text, not the ADR markdown.
lessons.fix: Write Python to a real file. Pipe git show into that file via python3 script.py. Never mix heredoc-in-subshell with piped input.
lessons.evidence: 12/12 SKIP invalid record — all with empty $out from Python.

lessons.title: Gate existence is not gate coverage
lessons.symptom: Empty adr-catalog.json passed all gates and shipped in commit.
lessons.root_cause: No gate asserted non-empty catalog content. G01–G04 checked file presence and schema, not results.
lessons.fix: Every artifact whose content matters must have a gate asserting non-trivial content (length > 0, expected anomalies present/absent).

lessons.title: jq -s on NDJSON produces one element per line, not a nested array
lessons.symptom: Cannot index string with string (adr_id) when merging allocation registry with canonical ADR NDJSON.
lessons.root_cause: jq -s slurps each JSON value as a top-level element. NDJSON has one value per line, so jq -s produces N elements, not 1 array. Accessing .[1] returns the first NDJSON line, not the array.
lessons.fix: Pre-wrap NDJSON: jq -s . file.ndjson > wrapped.json, then use jq --slurpfile dec wrapped.json and access $dec[0] as the array.

lessons.title: Even $TMPDIR can be cleared between Termux sessions
lessons.symptom: $TMPDIR/twgt-ei existed in one session but was gone on the next. Rebuild failed at first step with No such file or directory.
lessons.root_cause: Termux $TMPDIR (= $PREFIX/tmp) is not guaranteed to persist across sessions or pkg upgrade.
lessons.fix: For pipeline caches that must survive, use $PROJECT/.cache/<pipeline>/. Add .cache/ to .gitignore. Reserve $TMPDIR for genuinely ephemeral single-session scratch.

lessons.title: Network failures are not data-integrity failures
lessons.symptom: G06 failed on first strict run because 4 forks had PARENT_HEAD_UNREACHABLE from mobile network timeouts. On retry, 3 of those recovered but 3 different forks failed. A strict all-forks-ENRICHED gate would never pass reliably on Termux mobile.
lessons.root_cause: Termux on mobile networks has intermittent TLS/443 timeouts. Treating transient network errors as data-integrity failures makes the gate depend on network weather, not system state.
lessons.fix: Classify non-ENRICHED states as (a) structural failures (parent deleted, no common ancestor) → allowlist; (b) transient errors (network timeout, rate limit) → tolerate at commit and report count. Never conflate the two. Gate output must include both counts explicitly.
lessons.evidence: Run 1 non-ENRICHED: {5G-Proxy-Pro, hallmark, jsoncanvas, kepano-obsidian}. Run 2 non-ENRICHED: {5G-Proxy-Pro, sanitizers, Ventoid, open-design}. Only 5G-Proxy-Pro appears in both — the rest are network flake.

lessons.title: Registry snapshots are observations at time T, not assertions about now
lessons.symptom: M06 recorded unsloth as 6407 behind parent. Hours later, merge-upstream API reported not behind. Contradictory facts.
lessons.root_cause: The fork was synced between the two observations (either externally or via GitHub ruleset). M06 was correct at time T; the API is correct at T+N.
lessons.fix: When live API contradicts recorded registry data, re-run the observation to capture the new state. Commit the reconciliation. Never overwrite history silently.
lessons.evidence: M06 enriched.json: unsloth behind=6407. merge-upstream: not behind. Re-enrichment: behind=0, identical.
